---
title: "Spine"
---

The group follows one ordered list of topics (the spine). Each topic has one row per learning step with a resource per language, so people can work in Python, R or MATLAB and still be on the same week. The Python column is Jake VanderPlas's [Python Data Science Handbook](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/); the R and MATLAB resources are chosen to cover the same content and exercises.

Every module ends with a shared checkpoint: one question on one shared dataset that all three languages can answer. The weekly upload and the AI review compare answers to that checkpoint, since the code differs but the result should not. Seeds and default algorithms differ between languages, so checkpoints compare method and rough magnitude, not exact digits.

## Spine at a glance

Nine modules, 29 weeks. Modules 2 to 7 follow the handbook's chapter order; modules 0, 1 and 8 are added around it. The plan assumes about 32 usable weeks from late October to June, which leaves three spare for holidays and slippage. No dates are set yet - that's up to us.

| # | Module | Weeks | Handbook anchor | Shared checkpoint |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Setup and workflow | 1 | Ch. 1 (help, debugging, timing) | Run a script that loads the inflammation CSV and prints its size |
| 1 | Programming fundamentals | 3 | None; the handbook assumes Python. Prequel: A Whirlwind Tour of Python | Write a function and a loop: mean inflammation per day for all 12 files |
| 2 | Arrays and matrices | 3 | Ch. 2 | Per-day and per-patient mean, max and min; one logical mask; one sort |
| 3 | Tabular data | 5 | Ch. 3 | On the agreed dataset: missing values per column, one join, group means |
| 4 | Visualization | 3 | Ch. 4 | Recreate one agreed figure: daily mean with min-max band, plus a heat map |
| 5 | Machine learning foundations | 4 | Ch. 5.1-5.4 | Split iris, fit a classifier, report test accuracy and 5-fold CV accuracy |
| 6 | Supervised models | 4 | Ch. 5.5-5.8 | Four models on the same split, compared in one table |
| 7 | Unsupervised learning | 3 | Ch. 5.9-5.13 | PCA variance explained on iris; k-means with k=3 against species |
| 8 | Capstone | 3 | Ch. 5.14 (face detection pipeline) as a model | Each person's own mini-project, shown to the group |

Each module has its own page with objectives, resources per language and everyone's uploads.
